purpose: Form SH-1 is used for particulars of every share certificate as specified in the Companies (Share Capital and Debentures) Rules, 2014.
who: Not stated in the Rules text
when: Not stated in the Rules text
steps: Receive an application for the issue of a new share certificate from the Company Secretary or the person authorised by the Board on behalf of the concerned shareholder.
Issue a new share certificate for each such shareholder.
Record the particulars of every share certificate in Form No. SH-1.
checklist: Verify that the new share certificate states on the face that it was issued in lieu of the previous share certificate for the purpose of transfer to IEPF.
Ensure particulars of the share certificate are recorded in the register maintained for the purpose.
Verify that Form SH-1 is used as specified in the Companies (Share Capital and Debentures) Rules, 2014.
watch: Ensure particulars of every share certificate match Form No. SH-1.
